data.name: Rakhshan
data.gender_notes: Rakhshan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who guards and protects. The name Rakhshan carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Rakhshan usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child believed to bring peace, security and safety to the family
data.etymology: Rakhshan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakhshan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رَخشان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يدل على الاشراق والبريق
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَخشان هو اسم مؤنث يدل على الاشراق والبريق، مشتق من الفعل 'رَخَش' الذي يعني الاشراق والاضاءه. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك تأثيرًا إيجابيًا وملفتًا.

in_urdu.name: رخشان
in_urdu.meaning: روشناسی اور چمک کا اظہار کرنے والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: رخشان ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو اردو میں روشناسی اور چمک کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے جو الاشراق والاضاءه کے معنی رکھتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام روایتی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रखशान
in_hindi.meaning: रोशनी और चमक का प्रतीक नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: रखशान एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो हिंदी में रोशनी और चमक के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा की जड़ों से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है उजाला और प्रकाश। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: رَخشان
in_pashto.long_meaning: رَخشان د مؤنث نوم دی چې په پښتو کې د روښنيا او ځلېدونکي معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي لغت څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د اشراق او اضاءه معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې دا نوم دودیز او روحاني اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Rakhshan
in_english.meaning: a name symbolizing illumination and radiance
in_english.long_meaning: Rakhshan is a feminine given name that symbolizes illumination and radiance. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'r-kh-sh', it signifies brightness, shining, and luminosity. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with positive attributes such as enlightenment and charm. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a radiant personality. The name carries spiritual significance, implying a person who brings light and positivity to those around them.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rakhshan holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic community as it is an evocative reminder of the protective nature of Allah (God) towards his believers. Rakhshan is also a popular name for children, particularly in Iran and Pakistan, and is often given to remind parents of their responsibility to protect and guide their children.
data.spiritual_significance: In an Islamic context, the name Rakhshan represents the protective and nurturing role of Allah towards his creation. The name also encourages believers to emulate this divine attribute by being protective and caring towards others. Furthermore, it is a reminder of the importance of seeking Allah's protection and guidance in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector" symbolizes The one who guards and protects. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rakhshan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rakhshan was a Persian princess in the 6th century who is known for her beauty and bravery. The name Rakhshan carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rakhshan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Rakhshan in Karachi, Pakistan attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Rakhshan, which means "Protector". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
